representative_scale.preferred_gpu: H100, as specified in brief; GPU model must be recorded and held fixed

configuration.note: Constraint tolerance is integrator configuration, not an acceptance tolerance.

energy_series.reason: Driver collects 100 energies per replica internally but serializes only mean and final; full series must be retained by later implementation to test series identity.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter starts after PDB parsing, force-field/system construction and platform selection, before replica loop; ends after all contexts/integrators deleted. Includes integrator/context creation, initialization, compilation, integration, 100 energy queries per replica, reductions and teardown. Excludes package install, input loading/system construction and output serialization.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context creation, position/velocity initialization; ends after integration and energy queries.
timing_scope.candidate: Measure same fixed ensemble completion scope and include concurrent worker/context start and teardown; use same single GPU. No candidate driver command published in brief.
timing_scope.warmup_reason: No separate warmup prescribed in supplied fixed-work driver.

scientific_outcomes: Potential energy samples every 250 steps requested by brief; supplied driver retains summaries only.
scoring_interface.reason: No independent fixed-work energy values or published acceptance tolerance. NVIDIA throughput observation is a reference only. Brief speedup ranges and energy-invariance statements are hypotheses, not published acceptance criteria.

repeatability.control: Keep GPU model, software, system, seeds, precision and deterministic-force property fixed. Each replica starts from published coordinates, with seeded initial velocities and integrator.
repeatability.repeat_count_reason: Brief supplies no prescribed repeat count or statistical acceptance rule.
repeatability.numerical_acceptance_reason: Bit identity is predicted, not established on CUDA. Same-seed sequential run-to-run variation fallback is unspecified numerically. Do not invent epsilon or infer tolerance from variation.
repeatability.verification_status: Brief reports CPU-only smoke test; CUDA ensemble not reproduced during intake.

reference_comparison.applicability: NVIDIA approximate throughput reference uses fixed-time benchmark.py; no strict numeric pass/fail for fixed-work ensemble.

budget_notes: Defaults retained: setup, anchors, profile, method_setup, method_run 1200 s; tests 900 s; evaluate 2400 s. Brief estimates about one minute on H100, a few minutes on slower GPUs; not independently measured. Fixed scale only.
gate_scripts_reason: No gate script paths or commands supplied. JSON structure and evidence completeness checked locally; no build or workload executed.
